title: Perturbing human V1 degrades the fidelity of visual working memory
goal: Recreate the original findings and separately exceed them on the same source-paper task: TMS effects on spatial memory error, alpha lateralization and occipital alpha/beta responses.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: executable submitted analysis and source-native outputs for the complete original finding and companion panel.
Improvement: candidate outputs and a comparison on the same original task under improvement.v1.json.
Separate evidence for both outcomes under matched paper+data and paper+data+author-code conditions.
success_criteria: Assess reproduction and improvement independently under reproduction.v1.json and improvement.v1.json; do not combine their scores.
Preserve the original task, full panel, permitted observations, metrics, aggregation and required companion controls.
Reproduction requires a source-grounded computation and independently verified granular outputs; copying published findings alone is insufficient.
Improvement requires the unchanged improvement contract's same-task comparison, uncertainty and admission rules.
Use outcomes.v1.json for the matched information conditions and budgets; a declared contract or admitted receipt is not scientific qualification.
Author-baseline replay remains calibration. Historical reconstruction attempts retain their original scope and are not promoted to new qualified AI reproduction results.

lineage_and_loader_evidence.assessment: OSF masterTFR_allsubs.mat has15participant arrays and behavioralData_allsubs.csv; author source IDs agree. Original cluster_stats_TFR.m hardcodes16, so unchanged execution is not ready.

input_routes.license: Public access, but OSF node_license is null; redistribution license unresolved.

lineage_and_loader_evidence.source_inspection_level: Saved metadata, author documentation and selected source inspection; this audit did not newly read payloads.

data_contract.neural: Actual HDF5 metadata shows mTFR/NT and mTFR/T, pin/pout and ipsi/contra/all fields. Full-sensor powspctrm has HDF5 shape [15,200,53,62], corresponding to MATLAB [62 channels,53 frequencies,200 times,15 participants]. Single-region arrays preserve 15 participants. These are physiological time-frequency inputs, not group test statistics.
data_contract.labels: NT=no TMS, T=TMS; pin/pout=target inside/outside phosphene field. Source explicitly lists retained IDs [1,3,5,6,7,10,12,14,15,17,22,23,25,26,27] and aligns sensors by stimulated hemisphere.
data_contract.time_alignment: mTFR time and freq arrays are present. The author figure selects 0.5–2 seconds versus 3–4.5 seconds and 7–20 Hz; a revised endpoint must be frozen separately.
data_contract.split: Pair whole participants across conditions; all days of a person remain together. Trial-level behavioral data can support within-person contrasts, not independent trial-count inference.
data_contract.controls: Pre-TMS baseline, opposite visual hemifield, spatial specificity, blink/ocular contamination, and post-pulse artifact interval. Published processed arrays cannot independently test the original artifact removal.

versions_and_loader_contract.scope_description: Recompute the participant-paired EEG time-frequency perturbation effect and accompanying trial-level behavioral contrasts from released derivatives. This bounded scope does not repeat TMS delivery, raw EEG artifact rejection, or MRI targeting.

input_assets.checksum_interpretation: Explicit sha256 fields retained; checksum/digest/ETag names are not silently reinterpreted. None means unrecorded, not verified.

official_code.lineage_limit: Author/source code meaning is preserved. A loader, demo, figure script and complete-paper implementation are not interchangeable.

provenance.interpretation: Pins bind saved local evidence. Asset hashes are source-reported unless an explicit acquisition receipt says otherwise.

improvement.action: The source tests a causal perturbation effect on behavior and EEG. Increasing an effect or its significance does not improve a prediction or estimator against known truth. Existing fixed-region and behavioral scorers reproduce specified summaries; selecting different windows or exclusions cannot become a same-task paper victory.
